conclusions.text: At the fixed historical baseline, all 224 subjects resolve to the pinned source collection and the three reports reproduce byte-for-byte; this does not validate boundaries or parent assignments.
The 2021 DZS roster establishes unit names/types/county grouping, not municipal polygon coordinates or boundary completeness.
The DGU anonymous ATOM listing may lead to useful newer evidence, but response, layer-specific terms, date and completeness were not verified.
Atlas county parents, four label candidates, seven unmatched roster entries and 13 geometry-type differences require separate adjudication.
